description: Create or update a reusable cover sheet with every designer option. heading may be empty to omit it. Use list_cover_sheets.defaultDesign to restore the website defaults. Use a new 64-character lowercase hexadecimal id and version:0 to create; use the saved version to update. Maximum 25 designs. Validates fit and preserves fixed envelope address windows. Requires production write access. Workspace authentication required.
name: save_cover_sheet
title: Save Cover Sheet
